timePicker.$description: A time-of-day field — the same trigger as DatePicker (its field recipe is resolved from date-picker.tokens.json, never re-declared here, so the two sit flush as one date + time field) that opens a Listbox of fixed slots ('09:30 AM EST', every 30 minutes by default). Pick-only, no free typing: a list of half-hours is faster to scan than a typed time is to validate, and it can't produce '9:7 PM'. The open list scrolls the selected slot (or the first one from 9 AM) into view. A clear (×) button appears once there's a value. The list rows are Listbox's single-select option recipe (resolved from listbox.tokens.json) — only what Listbox doesn't have lives here.

height.$description: 36px — declared, because Listbox's 8px padding + a 14px × 1.4 line would render 35.6px.

zoneColor.$description: The timezone suffix ('EST') is quieter than the time itself, so a column of slots scans by the numbers.

minWidth.$description: 160px — the list is never narrower than this, otherwise it matches the field's width.
